defs.def: to make a smile appear on your face 微笑；笑

ex.s: Mia was surprised but smiled gently.
ex.t: 苏柒柒很惊讶，却温柔的笑了笑。

ex.s: I flashed him an apologetic smile as I pulled out my Portuguese bankcard.
ex.t: 我一边露出歉意的微笑，一边掏出我的葡萄牙银行卡。

ex.s: I flashed him an apologetic smile as I pulled out my Portuguese bankcard.
ex.t: 我一边露出歉意的微笑，一边掏出我的葡萄牙银行卡。

ex.s: Despite her encouraging smile, I wanted to sink through the floor because I was unsure about its pronunciation as well as its meaning.
ex.t: 尽管她面带鼓励的微笑，我却恨不得找个地缝钻进去，因为我不确定它的发音，也不确定它的意思。

ex.s: Memories of their 67-year life together would always make her smile.
ex.t: 对他们67年共同生活的回忆总会让她露出微笑。

ex.s: Even today Mecca's kindness continues to make me smile.
ex.t: 即使在今天，麦加的善良仍然让我微笑。

ex.s: “I remember the first time I saw a humpback whale; it just rose out of the water like some prehistoric creature and I thought it was smiling at us.
ex.t: “我记得第一次看到座头鲸的时候，它就像某种史前生物一样从水中升起，我觉得它在对着我们微笑。

ex.s: She smiled at me and said if I needed help, she’d be right there, which I found quite comforting.
ex.t: 她对我微笑说如果需要帮助她就在那里，我觉得这很令人安慰。

ex.s: A simple greeting in their mother tongue can guarantee a smile from a total stranger and a tired traveller.
ex.t: 用他们的母语简单问候一句，就能让一个完全陌生的人和疲惫的旅客露出微笑。

ex.s: smile is no guarantee of quality service.
ex.t: 微笑不能保证服务质量。

ex.s: Emoji can help communication feel friendlier, and even a serious note can be softened with an encouraging smile.
ex.t: 表情符号能让沟通显得更友好，即使是严肃的留言，加上一个鼓励的微笑也能变得柔和。

ex.s: Sending smiling faces to colleagues may seem strange
ex.t: 给同事发送笑脸表情似乎很奇怪。

ex.s: She donates 10% of AilicCandy's profits to Big Smiles.
ex.t: 她将艾利坎迪10%的利润捐给"大微笑".

ex.s: A nervous night to be sure, but sometimes the spirits of nature smile on us all!
ex.t: 确是一个紧张的夜晚，但有时自然的精灵会眷顾我们所有人！

ex.s: As sad as it was, I couldn’t help smiling.
ex.t: 尽管这件事令人悲伤，我还是忍不住微笑了。

ex.s: Sometimes it’s good to just smile, nod your head and listen.
ex.t: 有时候，只要微笑、点点头并倾听就好。

ex.s: As sad as it was, I couldn’t help smiling .
ex.t: 尽管很令人难过，我还是忍不住笑了。

ex.s: Friendship soup Like any good soup, This won’t fail to make you smile when you’re feeling down.
ex.t: 友谊汤 就像任何好汤一样，当你心情低落时，它必定会让你露出微笑。

ex.s: Pour it into a pot an mix it with five grams of smiles.
ex.t: 把它倒进锅里，与五克微笑混合。

ex.s: "Twenty years is a long time." He smiled bitterly, not knowing where to go.
ex.t: “二十年是一段漫长的时光。”他苦涩地笑了笑，不知该去往何处。

ex.s: "Yes, sir," the young man smiled.
ex.t: “是的，先生，”年轻人笑了。

ex.s: "Instead, our results suggest that the successful dogs realized that a smiling mouth means the same thing as smiling eyes, and the same rule applies to an angry mouth having the same meaning as angry eyes.”
ex.t: “相反，我们的结果表明，成功的狗意识到微笑的嘴和微笑的眼睛表达的是同一意思，同样的规则也适用于生气的嘴和生气的眼睛含义相同。”

ex.s: But the good thing was she always had the smile that would make you feel like you just did something right.
ex.t: 但好的一面是，她总是带着那种让你觉得自己刚做了什么正确之事的微笑。

ex.s: His usual big toothy smile was absent today.
ex.t: 他今天惯常那种露齿大笑不见了。

defs.def: to say or express sth with a smile 微笑着说；微笑地表示

ex.s: Some looked like they had tally given up on life, while others seemed to be making the best of the situation, smiling and joking.
ex.t: 有些人看起来已经彻底放弃了生活，而另一些人似乎在尽力适应现状，微笑着开玩笑。

ex.s: They arrive at the class in low spirits and they leave with a smile.
ex.t: 他们情绪低落地来到课堂，却面带微笑地离开。

ex.s: While going through the pages, he kept saying, wide-eyed: “How can there be this many words?” After a while, he looked at me and asked, “Do you know all these words, Mom?” I smiled, “I definitely do not know all these words,” I said.
ex.t: 他翻着书页，睁大眼睛不停地说：“怎么会有这么多词？”过了一会儿，他看着我问：“妈妈，你认识所有这些词吗？”我笑着说：“我确实不认识所有这些词。”

ex.s: After that incident, I stopped acting as a “Chinese teacher.” Instead of correcting others when they were struggling to pronounce my name, I just smiled and nodded approvingly.
ex.t: 那次事件后，我不再担任“汉语老师”。“当别人挣扎着说出我的名字时，我没有纠正别人，我只是微笑着点头表示赞许。

ex.s: The teachers were smiling and praising me.
ex.t: 老师们微笑着称赞我。

ex.s: “I have an idea, but it might be a little crazy,” smiled Mom.
ex.t: “我有个主意，但可能有点疯狂，”妈妈笑着说。

ex.s: "I'm wondering what life is going to be like here." "Don't worry," he gave me a smile.
ex.t: “我想知道这里的生活会是什么样子。“别担心， ”他笑着对我说。

defs.def: to give a smile of a particular type 现出（某种）笑容

ex.s: I forced a smile, unsure how to respond further.
ex.t: 我勉强挤出笑容，不知该如何进一步回应。

ex.s: As they came in my direction, I put on my brightest and happiest smile.
ex.t: 当他们朝我走来时，我露出最灿烂最开心的笑容。

ex.s: "During a time of stress for families, it's nice to be able to help them smile and laugh," Parry said.
ex.t: “在家长们倍感压力的时候，能帮他们露出笑容和笑声是件好事，”帕里说。

ex.s: She hopes that every kid can have a clean mouth and a broad smile.
ex.t: 她希望每个孩子都能拥有干净的嘴和灿烂的笑容。

ex.s: Moore wants to use her unique talent to help others find their smiles.
ex.t: 摩尔想用她独特的才能帮助他人找到笑容。

ex.s: The family hugged and smiled through misty eyes and then laughed.
ex.t: 男孩把最后一个包扛到肩上，露出灿烂的笑容。

ex.s: “What I can say for the folks that gave the most, is that they were full of smiles,” Bridges said.
ex.t: "对于那些给得最多的人，我可以说的是他们满脸笑容，"布里奇斯说。

ex.s: Not only does this cafe serve up drinks, it also serves up smiles.
ex.t: 这家咖啡馆不仅提供饮品，还提供微笑。

ex.s: Gunter parked the taxi behind the bus, turned around, and looked at me with a big smile on his face.
ex.t: Gunter把出租车停在巴士后面，转过身，脸上挂着大大的笑容看着我。

ex.t: "我特别喜欢父母和患者看到他的作品时的反应。

ex.s: But his smile faded as he rubbed his beard with bony fingers, in thought.
ex.t: 但当他用瘦骨嶙峋的手指摩挲着胡须沉思时，笑容渐渐消失了。

ex.t: 爸爸说她可能很孤独，我应该坐下来倾听、点点头、微笑，也许她能把心里的郁闷发泄出来。
